messages:
orchid-corp Admin: Hi team — just finished SSO setup for our account 'orchid'. Console shows the project 'orchid-prod' but no API key was created after the OIDC flow. Screenshot attached. Please advise.

alex (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste the tenant_id and claim token you saw in the final step?

orchid-corp Admin: tenant_id: t-78a9, claim_token: ct_12345. We followed the guidestep, callback returned success but no key in Console.

provisioner-bot: Provision request received for claim `ct_12345` -> status: ENQUEUED -> PENDING.

kai (Infra): looking at the provisioner logs now. I see `bind_request` for ct_12345 failed with `403 project not found` at 2026-02-11T15:02:17Z, then the worker retried and bound the claim to `internal-provisioner-project` (fallback) at 2026-02-11T15:02:19Z.

maria (CS): The customer confirms `orchid-prod` exists and has id `pr-992` in their org. They can see it in the Console.

alex (Support): @kai — sounds like a race where org/project metadata wasn't available to the provisioner during the bind attempt. Can you try a manual rebind and surface the key?

kai (Infra): doing manual reconcile now. Command I ran:
```
rwctl claims inspect ct_12345 --json
rwctl claims rebind ct_12345 --project pr-992 --force
```
I also set claim status -> PROCESSED after rebind.

provisioner-bot: Rebind executed for ct_12345 -> target project pr-992. API key generated: sk_live_3x... (obfuscated).

alex (Support): I pushed the Console refresh to the tenant, you should see the new key under Settings -> API Keys. Can you check, @orchid-corp Admin?

orchid-corp Admin: I can see the new key now, successful. Thanks! :tada:

maria (CS): Thanks — logging this as an escalation ticket. Creating INC-2026-451 for postmortem and customer outreach.

kai (Infra): On action items: I'll add a short retry window in the provisioner for org/project resolution (5s with jitter) and add a guard to avoid binding to `internal-provisioner-project` unless explicitly required.

alex (Support): Noted. I'll follow up with the customer tomorrow to confirm no downstream issues. Closing this thread once CS confirms.

orchid-corp Admin: All good from our side — appreciate the quick help.
